status.description: Possible values are `pending`, `supported`, and `unsupported`. When `payout.status` is `pending` or `in_transit`, this will be `pending`. When the payout transitions to `paid`, `failed`, or `canceled`, this status will become `supported` or `unsupported` shortly after in most cases. In some cases, this may appear as `pending` for up to 10 days after `arrival_date` until transitioning to `supported` or `unsupported`.

value.description: The trace ID value if `trace_id.status` is `supported`, otherwise `nil`.
